Accuracy lab

Real measurements on synthetic test requests the model never trained on. "Familiar phrasing" uses the same writing styles as training. "Unfamiliar phrasing" uses styles, slang and typos the model never saw: the honest test.

Results by reader

Run Claude on the unfamiliar test set

Sends the 150 masked unfamiliar requests to Claude in three batches on your account, then scores them exactly like the model. This also measures Auto mode: the model answers when confident, Claude answers the rest.
